ApiNamedQuery.body2: SELECT Id, Name, LDGCRM_Email__c, LDGCRM_External_ID__c, LDGCRM_P3_Partner_Portal_Team_Name__c, LDGCRM_P3_Team_UUID__c, LGDCRM_P3_Partner_Portal_Admin__c, LDGCRM_contact__r.Name, LDGCRM_Application__r.Name, LastModifiedDate FROM LDGCRM_Application_Contact__c WHERE LGDCRM_P3_Partner_Portal_Admin__c = TRUE ORDER BY Name DESC
ApiNamedQuery.description: Login.gov Partnership Portal Integration. Partner Portal admins only. Takes no parameters, which is why it is the script default - the admin flag is hardcoded TRUE rather than parameterised, so a zero-argument call still means "the admins".
ApiNamedQuery.masterLabel: Login.gov Application Contacts - Partner Admin Only
